book.name: Annabi Esayi
book.title: Ala xa masenyi Annabi Esayi bɛ Ala xa masenyi Annabi Esayi bɛ

content: Ala xa konyi findife sɛrɛxɛ ra

content.text: Nde laxi won ma masenyi ra?
Nde Alatala sɛnbɛ toxi?
A xa konyi lu nɛ alɔ sansi xuri, naxan tixi bɔxi xare ma.
A to ki mu nu rayabu, a xa tofanyi mu gbo.
Mixi raɲaaxuxi nan nu a ra ɲama mu tinxi naxan na.
Tɔɔrɔmixi nan nu a ra, naxan darixi ɲaxankatɛ ra.
Mixie mu tinxi e ya tide a bɛ.
E nu yo a ma, e mu tide yo fixi a ma.
A bara won ma tɔɔrɛ findi a gbe ra,
a bara won ma kɔntɔfili findi a gbe ra.
Won tan bara a maɲɔxun a Ala nan a dankaxi,
a a xa tɔɔrɛ fatanxi Ala nan na.
Kɔnɔ a sɔxɔ nɛ won ma yunubie xa fe ra,
a butuxun won ma ɲaaxuɲa xa fe ra.
A ɲaxankatɛ sɔtɔ nɛ alako won xa yalanyi sɔtɔ,
a xa fie findixi kisi nan na won bɛ.
Won birin nu lɔɛxi nɛ alɔ xuruse naxee yensenma wula i,
kankan naxa siga a xa kira xɔn ma.
Kɔnɔ Alatala bara won ma yunubie kote dɔxɔ a xun.
Tɔɔrɛ nun fe xɔrɔxɔɛ to a li,
a mu a dɛ rabi hali keren.
A lu nɛ alɔ yɛxɛɛ naxan xaninfe a faxade.
A a sabari nɛ tɔɔrɛ kui,
alɔ yɛxɛɛ xabe maxaba tɛmui.
A to gɛ kiiti tinxintare sɔtɔde, a naxa faxa.
Nde nɔ a bade duniɲa mixie yi ra?
A ɲaxankataxi n ma ɲama xa yunubie nan ma fe ra.
E nu wama a fure ragatafe mixi ɲaaxie nan ya ma,
kɔnɔ a raɲɔnyi a ragata mixi bannaxie nan ya ma,
barima a mu mixi tɔɔrɔ, a mu mixi madaxu.
Alatala bara natɛ tongo a xa a ɲaxankata tɔɔrɛ ra,
kɔnɔ sɛrɛxɛ na ba yunubie xa fe ra,
a fama nɛ a bɔnsɔɛ tode, a bu abadan.
Alatala waxɔnfe rakamalima a tan nan saabui ra.
A na gɛ a xa wali rabade,
a fama nɛ sɛɛwade.
«N ma konyi tinxinxi ɲama findima nɛ tinxintɔɛe ra,
a e xun sara e xa yunubie xa fe ra.
N tide xungbe soma nɛ a yi ra,
a xunnakeli sare sɔtɔ sɛnbɛ ra,
a to faxa matandilae yi ra,
a nu bara a yɛtɛ fi sɛrɛxɛ ra mixi gbegbe xa yunubie xa fe ra.»
